identityTest.stableIdentity: An attributable assertion that one person holds one competency at a stated level remains identifiable independently of person, competency, scale, assessment and credential records.
identityTest.versionIdentity: A new asserter, basis, level, scale version, validity interval, assurance or evidence conclusion creates a new assertion or explicit successor.
identityTest.mastership: authorized capability-assertion issuer or HR evidence authority

invariants: Every assertion identifies one person, competency version, scale version and level.
Definition, scale, assessment, evidence and person assertion retain separate identities.
Self-declared, assessed, credential-derived and observed bases remain explicit and distinct.
A self-assessment never becomes verified evidence without an attributable verification act.
Course completion never creates a capability assertion automatically.
Credential validity never proves current competence.
Credential expiry preserves issuance history and may stale but never erase an assertion.
A position requirement never becomes an assertion about its occupant.
Revalidation, decay, supersession, withdrawal and revocation remain distinct transitions.
Changing level, basis or scale version creates a successor rather than rewriting history.
Missing or indeterminate evidence never becomes level zero.
Disclosure follows person-data purpose, scope and least-disclosure rules.
holds: Registry allocation is pending and no identifier may be guessed.

Privacy, assurance and revalidation policies require canonical governance.
Package conversion and live verification are pending.
